prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: production game PBR base-colour texture for a working harbour crane, square 2048 x 2048 seamless material scan.
Primary request: a highly realistic scan of weathered oxide-red industrial enamel on smooth fabricated steel. The whole image is a flat surface, photographed exactly front-on, with no perspective, no scenery, edge to edge. Represents a 1 metre square of actual painted steel. Rich subdued reddish brown, natural patchy sun fading, slight layers of older paint visible in a few small peeled patches. About 94 percent intact paint. Sharp realistic flaked chips, very small scratches, a few irregular 10-40 mm paint losses showing dark iron and reddish brown corrosion. Sparse dirty rain wash and salt-air oxidation. Wear islands should have coherent irregular edges, clustered wear rather than evenly scattered dots. Real smooth painted metal, with delicate orange peel paint microtexture, absolutely not stone, plaster, porous concrete, wood, or a grunge noise texture.
Colour: muted red oxide enamel, subtle warm fading, graphite exposed steel, a restrained deep ochre rust tone at the few paint losses. Colour variation should remain natural and low contrast. Avoid large orange stains and bright glossy red.
Lighting: flat diffuse albedo under uniform soft light, no directional illumination, no baked specular highlights, no cast shadows or corner shading. No raised features, no seams, no rivets, no bolts, no panel grid, no text, no letters, no labels, no borders or watermark. Exactly seamlessly tileable on both axes. Pin-sharp photographic detail, not painterly.
